description: This file is a header (.h) file defining the class NetworkManagerClient within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares methods for managing network interfaces, Wi-Fi configurations, and related operations, including Wi-Fi scan, connect/disconnect, and WPS functionalities. It also includes external dependencies on GIO, standard C++ libraries, and other NetworkManager-related headers.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing network management functionalities, including interface management, Wi-Fi operations, and WPS handling.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures the IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a specific interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Fetches IP settings of an interface for a given IP version.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists known saved Wi-Fi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently connected Wi-Fi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a Wi-Fi network to the list of known SSIDs.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a Wi-Fi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a Wi-Fi scan.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi scan was performed recently.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a given interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network based on provided info.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known Wi-Fi connection by ID.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Gets the current Wi-Fi state/status.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Retrieves signal quality metrics for a SSID.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops the ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection configurations.
